name: Tit for Tat
description: Starts with cooperation, then copies the last move.

name: Tit for Two Tats
description: Defects only after two consecutive defections.

name: Grim Trigger
description: Cooperates until the first defection, then always defects.

name: Win–Stay, Lose–Shift
description: Repeats its move after 3 or 5 points; switches after 0 or 1.

name: Another Jev
description: The same model and objective, making independent decisions.
